"""Underline all headlines in the unpacked quarterly_report.docx document.

Headlines are the paragraphs whose text is entirely uppercase (no lowercase
letters, non-empty). Each run in such a paragraph gets <w:u w:val="single"/>
in its run properties, with <w:rPr> inserted as the first child of <w:r> when
absent.
"""
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'
DOC = 'unpacked/word/document.xml'


def q(tag):
    return '{%s}%s' % (W, tag)


tree = ET.parse(DOC)
body = tree.getroot().find(q('body'))

headline_count = 0
for p in body.iter(q('p')):
    text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in p.iter(q('t'))).strip()
    if not text:
        continue
    if re.search(r'[a-z]', text):
        continue  # mixed-case body text, not a headline
    for r in p.iter(q('r')):
        rpr = r.find(q('rPr'))
        if rpr is None:
            rpr = ET.Element(q('rPr'))
            r.insert(0, rpr)  # rPr must precede other run children
        if rpr.find(q('u')) is None:
            ET.SubElement(rpr, q('u')).set(q('val'), 'single')
    headline_count += 1

tree.write(DOC, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8')
print('underlined headline paragraphs: %d' % headline_count)

"""Underline all headlines in quarterly_report.docx (unpacked Office XML).

Headlines are identified as paragraphs whose visible text is non-empty,
contains at least one letter, and is entirely uppercase (all-caps section
titles). For each such paragraph, every run gets <w:u w:val="single"/> in its
run properties. File encoding (ascii + numeric entities) is preserved.
"""
import os
import re

try:
    from defusedxml import minidom
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    from xml.dom import minidom

W_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
PATH = os.path.join("unpacked", "word", "document.xml")


def para_text(p):
    parts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "t"):
        if t.firstChild is not None:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue)
    return "".join(parts)


def is_headline(p):
    text = para_text(p)
    if not text.strip():
        return False
    return any(c.isalpha() for c in text) and text.isupper()


def underline_runs(p):
    for r in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "rPr")
        rpr = rprs[0] if rprs else r.insertBefore(
            r.ownerDocument.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:rPr"), r.firstChild)
        if not rpr.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "u"):
            u = rpr.ownerDocument.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:u")
            u.setAttributeNS(W_NS, "w:val", "single")
            rpr.appendChild(u)


def main():
    dom = minidom.parse(PATH)
    body = dom.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "body")[0]
    count = 0
    for p in body.getElementsByTagNameNS(W_NS, "p"):
        if is_headline(p):
            underline_runs(p)
            count += 1
    with open(PATH, "w", encoding="ascii", errors="xmlcharrefreplace") as f:
        dom.writexml(f, encoding="ascii")
    # Collapse expanded empty elements back to self-closing form.
    with open(PATH, "r", encoding="ascii") as f:
        xml = f.read()
    xml = re.sub(r"<([\w:]+)([^>]*?)></\1>", r"<\1\2/>", xml)
    with open(PATH, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
        f.write(xml)
    print("underlined %d headline paragraph(s)" % count)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    from xml.dom import minidom

    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:

    print("underlined %d headline paragraph(s)" % count)

import os
import re
import tempfile

    from defusedxml import minidom
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    from xml.dom import minidom

W_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
